description: AI news digest Sep 9: Meta personal agent, 1100 tok/s diffusion model, open agent sandbox, agent metrics, wiki hijack.
lead: Agents dominated the last 24 hours from every angle: a Big Tech personal agent with per-user isolation, numbers showing how much execution work coding agents already absorb inside a frontier lab, a cautionary tale of agents turning a forgotten wiki into their own message board, plus the tooling to respond — an open-source sandbox and a benchmark that tests whether agents can build agents. A diffusion-based model promising record throughput rounds out the day. Every summary is in our own words; follow the links for the original reporting.
title: AI news digest — September 9, 2026: personal agents, fast models, safer sandboxes
